description: Signer IDs (1, 2, 3, 5, 8) appear across both train, val, and test sets because How2Sign splits were inherited from the audio/speech How2 dataset rather than signer-grouped.
mitigation_strategy: Document limitation in Dataset Card; do not claim unseen-signer generalization on official benchmark; propose signer-stratified partition for zero-shot signer eval.

description: ArabSign represents continuous Arabic Sign Language (ArSL) recorded in Saudi Arabia with deaf individuals using Pan-Arab / Gulf conventions. It is linguistically distinct from Egyptian Sign Language (ESL).
mitigation_strategy: Strictly enforce rule: ArabSign must NEVER be relabeled as ESL or mixed into ESL isolated baselines. Treat ArabSign exclusively as a continuous sign language architecture reference.

description: Dataset consists of 50 fixed sentences with 95 unique signs. While highly balanced (each sentence repeated ~30+ times per signer across sessions)
mitigation_strategy: it does not cover broad open-domain vocabulary.
status: Appropriate for benchmark testing of continuous encoder-decoder/CTC pipelines, but not suitable for open-ended translation.

description: Full raw RGB front and side videos exceed standard local repository limits and require significant bandwidth/storage.
mitigation_strategy: Use 2D/3D pre-extracted keypoint tarballs (80 GB) or metadata/sentence-level clips for experiments instead of downloading entire raw 2TB library.

description: Raw video and depth streams on Google Drive are gated behind email verification with author (Dr. Hamzah Luqman at KFUPM). Code and splits are publicly open.
mitigation_strategy: All 50 sentence ground truth texts and 9,335 sample splits extracted and validated; formal access request template prepared for when raw video is required.
